usageLimit.title: Usage Limit

notDefinedHint.DIRECT: Uses the person's Team Limits, the Public Use Limit or their User's Total Model Limit, whichever applies first.
notDefinedHint.TEAM: Members use their other Team Limits, the Public Use Limit or their User's Total Model Limit.
notDefinedHint.PUBLIC: People using this model because it is public use their User's Total Model Limit or the General Platform Limit.
notDefinedHint.MODEL_TOTAL: There is no total for everyone together.
notDefinedHint.PLATFORM: People with no other limit have no limit.
notDefinedHint.TEAM_TOTAL: There is no total across all models for this team.

unlimitedHint.DIRECT: No cap for this person on this model, whatever their Team Limits or the Public Use Limit allow. The model total still applies.
unlimitedHint.TEAM: No cap on the calls this team's limit applies to. Unlimited Team Limits apply before Team Limits with rules.
unlimitedHint.PUBLIC: No cap on public use. The model total still applies.
unlimitedHint.ALL_MODELS: Exempts the person from the General Platform Limit.

usageLimit.noRules: Add a rule to cap use. A call must pass every rule.
usageLimit.allRulesApply: Every rule applies. A call must be within all of them, so the first rule used up stops it.

rule.computeHint: Compute Time is the time the model spends answering, in milliseconds. It is the measure for self-hosted models, whose GPUs are already paid for.

usageLimit.noKnownPrices: This model has no known prices
usageLimit.eachMemberNote: For each member rules count only the calls this team's limit applies to.
usageLimit.costAcrossModelsNote: Models without known prices are not counted by cost rules. Add a token rule to cover them.
usageLimit.teamTotalTokensNote: Cost is the natural measure for a total across models, since tokens from different models are not alike.
usageLimit.windowsNote: Minute and hour rules slide. Day, week, month and year rules start again at the start of each calendar day, week, month or year in UTC.

errors.addMembersFailed: There was an error adding the selected members.

success.membersAdded: Selected members have been added successfully.
